key_insight: An optimal gate-packing strategy can reduce the entanglement cost of distributing a Quantum Fourier Transform circuit across multiple QPUs while preserving its unitary behavior.
engineering_relevance: This work supports scalable quantum hardware architectures by showing how to partition an important subroutine, the QFT, with fewer inter-QPU e-bits and practical teleportation overhead.
method: Formulate QFT circuit partitioning around minimizing e-bit count.
Use optimal gate-packing to rewrite the circuit for distributed execution.
Compare against prior analytical QFT partitioning methods and general-purpose partitioners.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports both comparative evaluation of the proposed partitions and validation by implementing the partitioned circuit on quantum hardware.
watch_item: Hardware validation is promising, but real systems may still face noise, connectivity, and teleportation overheads that affect the realized benefit.
paper_title: Towards an Optimally Distributed Quantum Fourier Transform Circuit
